notation: Token groups components consume. Values live in the sources; the DTCG files are generated.

color-roles.summary: Semantic color roles per scheme, from Spectrum: bg, fg, border, overlay, inverse, backdrop, selected; primary, secondary, neutral, critical, warning, success and info each with solid, solidHover, subtle, subtleHover, border, fg and steps 1-12; data 1-6; focusRing; and the scheme-aware shadows (sm, md) colored by the shadow role.

motion.summary: durations.<spring> and easings.<spring>, used as a pair.

geometry.summary: Theme geometry parameters (--ui-unit, --ui-border, --ui-radius-scale, container pad/gap) and the derived per-element variables.
